name: Niillas Sara
post: speaker of the Ealat colony council, Hesker IV

values: keeping the Federation's hands off what the colony built
traits: remembers every slight to the colony
persona.tired_of: Colonial Office inspectors who treat a herding colony as a museum
persona.wrong_about: that the calves' stiff sickness on the Ninth is from the steep ground and has nothing to do with the children
persona.cares_about: the colony choir, which he leads; he has the best voice in Javri and knows it

toward.juuso: Useful while she blames the flies.
toward.eira: She spoke against him at council; he hasn't forgotten.

agenda.goal: Keep any cull, and the Federation, off the herds
agenda.next_step: receive the Enterprise warmly and steer them to Dr. Juuso's reedfly plan

agenda.goal: Keep the Ninth open: the old pastures are grazed bare

relationships.eira: Opponent at council; her siida grazes the Ninth.
